csv_scope_of_work: The McKenzie County Commission requests proposals to perform architectural services for the Rawson Shop. The County currently has a shop in Alexander, ND located at 2675 137T Ave NW Alexander, ND 58831. The existing PEMB structure has a broken and cracked floor with no floor drains. The County desires to saw cut and remove a large portion of the floor which is approximately 10,000sqft. replace the concrete and install a linear drain with oil and water separators, and prep for radiant in floor heating. The work to be performed by the Consultant includes, but is not limited to, assisting the County with slab design, assessment of exiting building, completing all required permitting, preparing final construction documents, bidding, contract administration, and construction inspection.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Planning/Master Planning, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
